title: Codex Plugin Manifest (legacy .codex-plugin dialect)
description: Codex reads four manifest paths in order: root plugin.json when it declares the agent-plugins.org v1.0.0 $schema, then .codex-plugin/plugin.json, .claude-plugin/plugin.json, .cursor-plugin/plugin.json. This schema describes the legacy nested dialect; root plugin.json is validated by the vendored agent-plugins.org schema in schemas/1.0.0/plugin.schema.json. Authored from the OpenAI Codex source; OpenAI publishes no JSON Schema for the legacy dialect.
$comment: Provenance: authored (not upstream-vendored) 2026-09-08. Sources: openai/codex codex-rs/core-plugins/src/manifest.rs, codex-rs/utils/plugins/src/plugin_namespace.rs, codex-rs/exec-server-protocol/src/protocol.rs (DISCOVERABLE_PLUGIN_MANIFEST_PATHS), and the bundled plugin-creator skill (plugin-json-spec.md, validate_plugin.py). The runtime deserializer and the scaffold validator disagree: the runtime reads hooks and commands, while validate_plugin.py rejects both. Fields the runtime reads are marked; interface is required by the scaffold validator only.

name.description: Plugin identifier. Falls back to the plugin-root directory name when absent. Runtime pattern: [A-Za-z0-9_-]+(\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+)*.

id.description: Accepted by the scaffold validator only; not read by the runtime deserializer.

version.description: Semantic version. The scaffold validator requires it; the runtime defaults to None. Cachebuster form: <base>+codex.<token>.

url.description: Must be an absolute https:// URL per the scaffold validator.

skills.description: Relative ./ paths to skill directories or files. Supplements default discovery rather than replacing it.

mcpServers.description: A path to an MCP configuration file, or an inline server map. The scaffold validator requires a path that normalizes to exactly .mcp.json; mcp.json without the dot is not accepted.

apps.description: Path to a .app.json file. Must exist when declared; the file must contain {"apps": {"<key>": {"id": string, "category"?: string}}}.

hooks.description: Path(s) to hooks file(s) or inline hook configuration. Read by the runtime; rejected by the scaffold validator.

commands.description: Read by the runtime for install-time command-to-skill migration; rejected by the scaffold validator.

interface.description: UI and listing block. Required by the scaffold validator; optional for the runtime.

defaultPrompt.description: Starter prompts. At most 3 are used; each is truncated at 128 characters.

composerIcon.description: Asset path; must be a real file in the archive.
